name: 그래디언트 마이크로 텍스처
description: 조사합니다 smooth regions for natural micro-texture from camera sensors. AI images lack sensor-level noise in 기울기s, producing unnaturally clean smooth areas.
mechanism: 분석합니다 image 기울기 fields 감지하기 위해 unnaturally smooth regions lacking micro-texture. AI images produce suspiciously clean 기울기 transitions especially in backgrounds.
parameters: Gradient operator: Scharr, Window: 16x16 sliding, Metrics: 기울기 엔트로피, smoothness ratio
accuracy: 중간 - 70-80%, higher for diffusion model outputs
source: Nataraj et al. (2019) Detecting GAN generated Fake Images using Co-occurrence Matrices
useCase: Identifying AI 생성 smooth 기울기s lacking natural micro-texture

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Tanaka, K. et al. (2019). Distinguishing Computer Graphics from Natural Images. Digital Investigation.

strengths:
• Detection vùng 기울기 quá sạch đặc trưng AI
• Chi phí tính toán thấp
• Hoạt động tốt với ảnh có vùng mượt lớn
limitations:
• 스튜디오에서 잘 촬영된 이미지는 오탐 가능성
